versions.changelog:
ai-ppt-powerpoint-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI PPT PowerPoint Generator skill.
- Generate multi-page PowerPoint-style image carousels using AI models and templates.
- Supports customizable aspect ratios and page sizes (e.g., 4:5, 1080x1350).
- Editable text layers for headlines, content, and footers on generated posters.
- Requires OneKey Gateway access key for API usage.
